sections.content:
Now I can see the situation more clearly:
- Player at (28-31, 9-11)
- White bar at (28-31, 4-8) on LEFT of player (16 pixels, expanded)
- Left target at (28-31, 16-19) - still charcoal (inactive)
- Blue bar at (28-31, 28-39)
- Bottom target at (36-39, 40-43) - still charcoal (inactive)
The white bar is on the LEFT of the player, and the left target is to the RIGHT of the player. So the white bar is on the WRONG side of the target. I need the white bar to be on the RIGHT side of the player (so it's between the player and the target).
To get the white bar on the RIGHT:
- Move RIGHT so the white bar appears on the RIGHT side
- Then the white bar will be at cols 12-16 (adjacent to target at cols 16-19)
Wait, but the white bar is 16 pixels (4x4 hollow frame). When on the RIGHT, it would be at cols 12-15 (if player at cols 9-11). The target is at cols 16-19. So the white bar at cols 12-15 would be adjacent to the target at col 16.
Let me try moving RIGHT to get the white bar adjacent to the left target from the LEFT side.
